author: blu
body: Hires fix / multi-pass upscaling for diffusion models. Generates at a lower resolution first, upscales the latents, then runs a second denoising pass at the target resolution. This produces sharper, more detailed images than generating at high resolution directly (which tends to produce duplicated subjects).

author: blu
body: Also supports latent upscale (upscale in latent space without decoding/re-encoding) and simple nearest/bilinear pixel upscale.
